title: Plan and implement read-only Git history timeline
body: Plan and implement a native Git History window inside each project, inspired by the JetBrains Rider log: scrollable commit rows with colored branch/merge graph lanes, commit messages, branch/tag labels, author, and date. Keep Git reads off the GUI thread and scrolling fast on large histories. Start from src/wm.rs and docs/HANDOFF.md; validate graph behavior with tests and GUI screenshots. Scope is viewing only: defer branch selector and checkout/switching to a second task; no diffs, search, context menus, or other Git operations.
